checks.text: The page displays the heading "Time Tracker" and a button labelled "Start Timer".
Clicking "Start Timer" changes the button label to "Stop Timer" and displays a timer counting up from "00:00:00".
After the timer has run for 60 seconds, clicking "Stop Timer" adds a new row to the table with the task name "Default Task" and duration "00:01:00".
Typing "Deep Work" in the field labelled "Task Name" and clicking "Start Timer" then "Stop Timer" after 30 seconds adds a row with task name "Deep Work" and duration "00:00:30".
The table displays a column labelled "Total" which shows the sum of all durations. With one session of "00:01:00", the cell shows "00:01:00".
Clicking the button labelled "Delete" on the row with task name "Deep Work" removes that row and updates the "Total" to "00:00:00" if no other rows exist.
Clicking the button labelled "Export CSV" downloads a file containing the header "Task,Duration" and a row "Deep Work,00:00:30".
The tab labelled "History" is visible. Clicking it shows the table of sessions. The tab labelled "Timer" is active by default.
Reload keeps the session with task name "Deep Work" and duration "00:00:30" in the table.
